stageReason: A second reply to 2.Nf3; a queen sacrifice and a two-bishop mate.

idea.ru: Слон связал коня, но конь бьёт на e4: взятие ферзя ведёт к мату двумя слонами.
idea.en: The bishop pins the knight, but the knight takes on e4: capturing the queen allows mate by the two bishops.
